title: Write complete science sentences
objective: Repair an incomplete idea and separate two complete ideas.

slides.title: Test each part aloud
body: A complete clause has a subject and a verb and can stand on its own.
A clause starting with because needs a main clause. Two complete sentences need a full stop or a suitable link.

slides.title: Repair two common draft errors
body: Fragment: “Because the light was weak.” Add the result: “Because the light was weak, we moved the plant.”
Run-on: “We saw a bird it flew away.” Repair: “We saw a bird. It flew away.”

slides.title: Read the first case together
body: Student draft: “Because the pond was dry. We saw no frogs we wrote a note.”

slides.title: Try it with a partner
body: Find the incomplete part. Why is it incomplete?
Separate the two complete ideas after the full stop.

slides.title: Try a new case
body: Student draft: “Because the garden was quiet. We heard a bird we wrote a note.”

slides.title: Work on your own
body: Find the incomplete part. Why is it incomplete?
Separate the two complete ideas after the full stop.
Repair the whole draft. Keep the original ideas.

slides.title: Read the repair aloud
body: For each sentence, name who or what did something. Point to the word that gives the action.
